conventions.supply_rounding: days_of_supply = floor(quantity_on_hand / units_per_day), computed on exact fractions; supply is never rounded up. leftover_units is what remains beyond the last full day and buys no further full day
conventions.order_by: order_by = runs_out_on minus lead_time_days, where runs_out_on is the first day the supply on hand does not fully cover
conventions.days_remaining: full_dose_days_remaining counts days from as_of (or from coverage_starts_on, whichever is later) through last_full_dose_day inclusive, and is 0 once the supply is exhausted

count_basis.doses_on_count_day_taken: quantity_on_hand was counted after that day's doses were taken, so coverage_starts_on is the day after counted_on
count_basis.doses_on_count_day_pending: quantity_on_hand was counted before that day's doses were taken, so coverage_starts_on is counted_on itself
